allowed_subnets.description: List of subnets allowed to query this Chrony server. Empty list = deny all.

chrony_log_dir.description: Directory where Chrony logs are stored.

chrony_log_rotate_count.description: Number of old log files to retain (chrony logrotate count).

clientloglimit.description: Maximum age of client log entries (e.g., '1h' = 1 hour). Controls log growth.

makestep_burst.description: Number of steps to allow in quick succession (used with makestep_threshold).

makestep_threshold.description: Step the clock immediately if offset > this threshold (seconds), instead of slewing.

maxupdateskew.description: Maximum acceptable clock skew (ppm) before updates are rejected. Helps avoid instability from erratic sources.

ntp_keys.description: Set to true if you use NTP authentication keys (chrony.keys file required).

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP servers to synchronize time with. Each entry supports iburst, prefer, and optional key.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server.

iburst.description: If true, send an initial burst of packets to synchronize quickly on startup.

key.description: Optional symmetric key ID for NTP authentication (must exist in keyfile). Set to null for no auth.

prefer.description: If true, prefer this server for synchronization.

stepthreshold.description: Minimum offset (seconds) required to trigger an initial step adjustment. 0 disables stepping.

time_source_path.description: Optional hardware or virtual time source (e.g., '/dev/ptp0' or custom VMware source). Leave null for auto.

vmware_log_priority.description: Priority level for VMware-related log messages (e.g., 'info', 'warn', 'err'). Set to null to disable VMware logging.

vmware_max_diff.description: Maximum allowed time difference (in seconds) between VMware Tools and Chrony before rejecting VMware time sync updates.

vmware_no_sync_source.description: Set to true to prevent Chrony from using VMware VMtime as a time source. Useful when VMware Tools sync is enabled but Chrony should rely on NTP instead.

vmware_slew_disabled.description: Set to true to disable slewvmw — i.e., Chrony will step the clock (not slew) on large VMware-initiated adjustments.

vmware_sync_disabled.description: Set to true to disable VMware Tools time sync integration. When enabled, Chrony ignores VMware time sources.
